_readme: Quality ratchet: these numbers are the worst accepted state. A PR may add code but may not worsen any metric - not even by one unit. Re-freezing is deliberate (`pnpm quality --update-baseline`) and the reason goes in the commit body; this file is versioned precisely so the change shows in the diff.
_mode: Every metric here uses "baseline" (freeze today's value, only allow improvement) - the mode for a repo with existing debt. A fresh repo may prefer "floor" with explicit thresholds; see compare.mts.

coverage-percent.label: Line coverage
coverage-percent.note: Covered lines / instrumented lines over the wide slice (vitest.quality.config.ts). Catches dilution; the per-file ratchet catches local regressions.

uncovered-lines.label: Uncovered lines
uncovered-lines.note: Informative only - the per-file ratchet (uncoveredByFile) is what fails the build.

duplication-percent.label: Duplicated lines
duplication-percent.note: jscpd over src/. An agent edits one copy and misses the others - duplication is refactor risk, not aesthetics.

pure-rule-outside-domain.label: Pure rules outside the domain
pure-rule-outside-domain.note: A .ts outside the rule directories WITH a unit test beside it - the signature of a business rule born at the edge. Complements the import-direction lint, which cannot see a rule that never reached domain/.

circular-dependencies.label: Circular dependencies
circular-dependencies.note: Strongly connected components in the production import graph (cycles.mts). A cycle means no file in it can be reused or understood alone. At 0, freezing makes cycles forbidden outright.

files-over-limit.label: Files over the line limit
files-over-limit.note: Production files over quality.lineLimit (size.mts). Big files are where the next agent edit turns into a mess.

cc-over-limit.label: Functions over the CC limit
cc-over-limit.note: Functions with cyclomatic complexity above quality.ccLimit (complexity.mts, default 5 per Richards & Ford). Every path is a test someone owes; generative AI accumulates accidental complexity - the ratchet watches the model's laziness.

explicit-any.label: Explicit `any`
explicit-any.note: AST count of any-keyword nodes in production files (any-count.mts). AGENTS.md bans new `any`; the ratchet lets legacy debt only shrink. Exists because flipping no-explicit-any to 'error' over legacy code breaks the build on day one.
